verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll/PEO platform, so a privacy control for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and Xero integration, and never mentions telemetry, analytics tracking or opt-out settings. Absence of evidence on an applicable axis is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
